description: Habib Insurance Company Limited is a general insurer and the oldest of the Habib family's group companies. Its founding members laid the groundwork for the business in Bombay in 1942, and the head office was moved to Karachi in 1947 after Partition. The company describes itself as the oldest and longest-tenured insurance company in Pakistan, writing general insurance — including health cover — through a branch network, and it has raised capital over the decades through the issue of bonus shares.
headOffice: 1st Floor, State Life Building No. 6, Habib Square, M.A. Jinnah Road, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
sourceNote: Company website (habibinsurance.net/company-profile for the 1942 Bombay founding, the 1947 move to Karachi and the 'oldest insurance company in Pakistan' claim; /contact-us for the head office address and UAN), and the chief executive's name from the company's own First Quarter March 2026 accounts published at habibinsurance.net/docs/First-Quarter-March-2026.pdf, read 2026-10-17.
